findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11 Inspector observed the calking on the hand sink in the back room to be in disrepair. PIC was made aware. PIC ensured inspector tor that the sink will be caulked to the wall properly. Ensure that the caulking is done in a manner that provide a smooth and easily cleanable surface.

(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Proper date marking and disposition
findings.comment:
3-501.17: There was observed 2 half gallons of milk in the cooler with an expiration date of 6-12-2023. These items were removed from service and discarded during today’s inspection. Ensure product is rotated and disposed of appropriately with expiration dates.
3-501.17: (A) Except for ROP, Refrigerated, RTE, TCS Food prepared and held in a food establishment for more than 24 hours shall be clearly marked to indicate the date/maximum of 7 days. Day of preparation is Day 1 (Pf). (B) Date marking may not exceed manufacturer’s use-by date (Pf). (C) Combined portions of food shall retain the date marking of the earliest-prepared food (Pf). (D) Approved date marking systems (C). (E)  Does not apply to repacked from a bulk container (C). (F) Does not apply to shellstock (C).  (G) Exemptions: prepared deli salads prepared according to 21 CFR 110; hard cheeses (39% moisture); semi-soft cheeses (50% or less); cultured dairy products (yogurt, sour cream, buttermilk); preserved fish (pickled herring, dried/salted); dry, fermented sausages (pepperoni); and salt-cured products (prosciutto and parma).

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The fan cages in the walk-in cooler are observed to have an accumulation of dust/debris. Ensure these fan cages are cleaned at a frequency necessary to maintain them clean. 
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Adequate ventilation and lighting; designated areas used
findings.comment:
6-303.11: There is observed a lightbulb burnt out in the walk-in beer cooler. Ensure this bulb is replaced to allow for appropriate lighting in this area.
6-303.11: The light intensity shall be at least a certain lux and present in certain areas.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: There is an observed accumulation of mold on the ice machine baffle in the storage room. Ensure this surface is cleaned and sanitized to prevent the contamination of ice.
4-602.11: (E) Surfaces of UTENSILS and EQUIPMENT contacting food shall be cleaned any time contamination occurs, at least 24 hours for certain UTENSILS (i.e. iced tea dispensers), before restocking self-service EQUIPMENT, in EQUIPMENT such as ice bins in frequency to prevent mold. At a frequency to preclude accumulation of soil or mold.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: The mop was observed to be stored in the basin of the mop bucket. This item was placed in the top portion of the mop bucket to allow for adequate air drying. Ensure this practice continues.
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: Fresh caulking is needed at the hand sink in the storage room. Ensure caulking is placed to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment: Coffee maker spouts soiled black. Ice flap in ice machine appears to have mold. Spouts in cappuccino machine have powder build up. Wash, rinse and sanitize these food contact surfaces. 750-800(b) To prevent cross contamination, kitchenware and food contact surfaces of equipment shall be washed, rinsed, and sanitized after each use.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment: No test strips available. Provide test strips for testing sanitizer concentration. Prepare according to label. 750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment: No soap in restroom. No paper towels at back hand sink. Provide soap and hand drying device at each hand sink. 750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.

findings.title: Food protection during storage, prepartion, display, service, transportation
findings.citation_text: 750.130 Observed multiple gallons of milk stored on the floor in the walk in cooler. Store milk six inches or higher off the floor.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.citation_text: 750.800 Observed what appears to be mold on the ice deflector of the ice machine. Wash, rinse, and sanitize food contact surface.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: The back outside of the ice chute from the soda machine is soiled. 750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris. Clean and maintain clean.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment: There is no cold running water at the 3 part sink. 750-820 For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing utensils and equipment, each compartment of the sink shall be supplied with hot and cold potable running water. Provide hot and cold running water at the 3 part sink for proper cleaning of food contact surfaces.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: Did not observe a thermometer in the small chest freezer.
findings.citation_text:
750.140(a) All refrigeration units used to hold potentially hazardous foods shall contain a conspicuously placed thermometer that is accurate to ±3°F.
Provide a thermometer in the freezer.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment:
Repeat: 1.Observed raw wood used as shelving in the back room.  New: 2.Observed duct tape to secure hoses at he 3-compartment sink.  
750-600 Non-food contact surfaces shall be smooth and easily cleanable.
Seal the wood.  If painting, paint a light color.  Remove the tape - use a durable material.

findings.title: Food contact surfaces of equipment and utensils clean
findings.comment:
Observed spots of mildew on the inside top ledge of the ice maker.  750-800
Clean and sanitize the inside of the ice maker and maintain clean.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
1.Observed the lid holders to the right of the soda machine to be soiled.  2.Observed debris in the ice cream freezer and on the door tracks.
750-800e Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned as often as is necessary to keep the equipment free of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.
Clean and sanitize the above listed items and maintain clean.

findings.title: Water source safe, hot, and cooled under pressure
findings.comment:
Did not observe a water supply to the center compartment of the 3-compartmetn sink.  Corrected:  The detergent and sanitizer setup was disconnected from the single faucet.  This is a temporary solution.  Provide a permanent fix.  A spot check will be conducted to assure compliance.
750-820 For manual washing, rinsing and sanitizing utensils and equipment, each compartment of the sink shall be supplied with hot and cold potable running water.
Provide hot & cold running water to each sink compartment.

findings.title: Cross-connections, back-siphonage, back-flow prevented
findings.comment:
1.Observed a flexible hose directly connected to the mop sink faucet.  Corrected:  The hose was removed.
750-1080 A hose shall not be attached to a faucet unless a backflow prevention device is installed. Install backflow prevention device.
Remove the hose when not using or install backflow prevention.
2.Did not observe an air gap for the ice maker.  Corrected:  The drain was propped up off the floor.  This is a temporary measure.  Install a permanent fix.
750-290 Ice storage bins shall be drained through an air gap. Provide an air gap.
Provide an air gap to prevent backflow.

findings.title: Restrooms with self-closing doors, fixtures operate properly, facility clean, supplied with hand soa...
findings.comment:
1.Did not observe towels at the hand sink in the back room.  750-1120e A supply of soap and sanitary towels (or a hand drying device) shall be provided at each lavatory.  Provide hand towels at the hand sink.
2.Did not observe the employee bathroom door to be self-closing.  750-1120 All restrooms must have self-closing doors, properly operating fixtures, be clean and have proper hand washing supplies in order to help facilitate good hygienic practices.  Provide properly designed and maintained restrooms.  Provide a self-closing door.

findings.comment:
Observed a package of raw bacon above cheese, cans of pop, etc.  Store raw food below ready to eat food.  Corrected:  Bacon was moved to the lowest shelf, next to the raw eggs. 
750-130(d) All food shall be stored properly in order to prevent cross-contamination.  Store ready to eat foods above or a way from raw foods.

Observed debris in a chest freezer.  Clean the freezer.
750-800d Food-contact surfaces of grills, griddles, and similar cooking devices and the cavities and door seals of microwave ovens shall be cleaned at least once a day.   The food-contact surfaces of all cooking equipment shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other accumulated soil.

findings.comment:
Observed the faucet at the three compartment sink to be leaking.  Repair the leak.
750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
Observed a large cut out in the cabinet wall where the mouse droppings were observed.  Repair the wall.
750-1210 All walls and ceilings must be in good repair and constructed to facilitate easy cleaning in order to reduce the potential for cross contamination and infestation by insects and rodents.  Provide properly constructed and clean walls and ceilings.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment:
There isn't an employee with a Food Service Sanitation Manager Certification.  Provide one full-time employee with the certification.
750-540 All Category II facilities must have at least one full-time Licensed Food Service Sanitation Manager employed at the facility to help ensure proper food handling.  Provide at least one fulltime Food Service Sanitation Manager.

findings.comment: Floors under shelving and equipmeent are soiled with debris. Section 750.1220 Clean the floors.

findings.title: Hot food at proper temperatures
findings.comment: 750.120a: Observed the hot holding/warmer box to be holding at 115 degrees F and the cheeseburgers and biscuit inside were approx. 106-110 F. The sandwiches had been out since about 9:00am and were discarded. The warming unit will be turned up to at least 140 F by replacing the light bulb inside because the unit itself cannot be "turned up" and no food will be placed inside until it is at proper temperature. The food inside shall be at 135 F or higher.

findings.title: No Certified Manager Present
findings.comment: 750.540a: Absence of an IL Certified Food Service Sanitation Manager at facility. At least one full-time employee shall be certified, but does not need to be present at all times.
